name: smart-ppt-designer
description: Native PPTX build & asset-pipeline scripts for the smart-ppt-designer skill package. This repository root is the SKILL package; the DSH plugin is in smart-ppt-studio/ and must be installed from that subdirectory: dsh plugin --profile web add github:hemu996/smart-ppt-designer#path:/smart-ppt-studio

dshPlugin.note: 安装地址必须包含 #path:/smart-ppt-studio；填仓库根地址会报「这个包没有声明组合包」。
